ms.report:
1. Developed educational Materials for student ambassadors
The team along with the facilitators have worked together to develop educational and resource materials to help train these selected ambassadors. These materials were developed with the goals and values of the program in mind. Some topics that were covered include Exploring Cardano and Project Catalyst, Intro to Yoroi and Town Hall Meetings, and Project Catalyst & IdeaScale Explained, Blockchain Fundamentals. Other presentations also include topics that focus on Leadership and Innovation. Additionally, the team came up with a detailed ambassador handbook that contains an overview of the Program and what to expect.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1F6O4ESn-ORqd1P8hKnnIW-nOzJaRSx_I?usp=sharing
 
2. Well-developed promotional materials for event:
In the past month, our team developed comprehensive marketing materials to effectively communicate the objectives, benefits, and activities of the Cardano Student Blockchain Ambassador Program. These materials were designed with a focus on clarity, engaging visuals, and a call to action. To ensure widespread awareness, we strategically utilized various channels, including our social media platforms such as Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook. Regular posts featuring highlights of the program, QnAs, and engaging visuals were shared to captivate our audience. Additionally, we leveraged relevant hashtags with the aim to expand our reach.
 https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1j9pEjiNrn5O4EWdin5WwEGiqM3REoR02?usp=sharing
﻿To further increase anticipation and engagement for the event, we encouraged ambassadors to create bespoke flyers announcing their participation in the event and share them on their social media. Some of these flyers can be found here:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1jlcZXkwyL2TOS2ilJD4qPsSskDB0B3cq?usp=sharing

ms.report:
As we reach the final milestone of the Cardano Student Blockchain Ambassador Program, we are excited to share our well-presented findings and insights. Our analysis includes data collected from feedback forms and direct interactions with our student ambassadors and mentors.
The results highlight the key areas where the program has made a
significant impact, showcasing the growth in knowledge in Cardano and project
catalyst, practical skills, and entrepreneurial mindset among our participants.
These insights are presented in a clear and easily understandable manner,
ensuring that all stakeholders can grasp the core outcomes of our initiatives.
Below are the links to our report and the response from our participants
respectively.
